title: Who designs HBM? Nvidia's NVHBM architecture makes the question far more complex
snippet: Samsung Electronics manufactures high-bandwidth memory (HBM) through a closed-loop, vertically integrated model: handling everything in-house from DRAM core dies and logic base dies to packaging and testing. Its HBM4, which entered mass production in February 2026, represents the pinnacle of this strategy: the core dies utilize Samsung's sixth-generation 1c DRAM process, while the base die is fabricated on Samsung Foundry's 4nm logic node, yielding a 100% Samsung-built chip.

title: China's shift away from Nvidia GPUs tests the limits of its AI chip supply chain

title: Why NAND spot prices fell 20% despite the AI storage boom
snippet: NAND flash spot prices have fallen about 20% since mid-to-late October 2026, even as AI demand continues to lift memory prices. Weak smartphone and PC sales, capacity expansion in China, and continued output from older fabs are weighing on mainstream NAND. Demand for enterprise solid-state drives (SSDs) in AI data centers, however, remains strong.
